title: What does the vacuum need to know?
instruction: A robot vacuum is supposed to clean the flat. Mark what its model must contain.
debrief: A model contains only what the purpose needs. For a vacuum, free space, obstacles and rooms are enough. The colour of the sofa isn’t.

items.why: Otherwise it would bump into everything.

items.text: How to get into the next room
items.why: Doors are the edges of the flat’s graph.
It doesn’t need it for vacuuming.

items.text: Whether there is a step below it
items.why: Without that it would fall down the stairs.
To a vacuum, the cat is just an obstacle.
It has to make it back to the charger.

items.text: Which picture hangs on the wall
items.why: The picture makes no difference at all to vacuuming.
